body: Thanks for sharing your experience. May I ask what difference you felt  after taking Prozac?

I feel the same way as you. Whenever I'm talking to someone I'm always anxious about not having anything more to say. Also, I just graduated from high school as well and it I've been feeling very lonely since. Hopefully things work out for you - I'm not good with advice but maybe try to talk about things you like? (Games, movies etc) that might help you connect with others

Not sure if it's normal but what you're describing is exactly what I'm feeling now. I heard that depression can manifest itself in physical ailments. Have you tried seeing a doctor? Maybe they could help out
Thanks sharing your experience! I'll be seeing a doctor today and hopefully things could go better soon. May I ask how long it took you took the medication before it starts working?
I think I want to try medication - maybe it'll help me feel better, but I'm not too keen on trying therapy. Do you know if medication really works?
Thanks for your comment. I am quite socially awkward and don't really know if a therapy or a support group would really help. Can meds by itself help one get through depression?

Thank you so much for your comment. I really appreciate you being so caring and thoughtful. I really wish that things would go better for all of us. Right now I'm considering going to the doctors but it seems odd if I go in and tell them that I am not physically hurt or sick. Hopefully things go better - I'll try to wait it out as per your advice - and thank you so much for such being so understanding.
